LibTmux.Creation

Description

Options and historical identities for detached session creation.

LibTmux.Server executes creation in IO through an existing pinned handle. Start from defaultSessionOptions; ordinary record updates select names, geometry, environment and the initial process. Option fields perform no IO.

A CreatedSession contains the actual references printed by tmux before after-hooks. It remains usable after the Server closes, but proves neither current liveness nor successful process exec. Acquire a fresh snapshot and use LibTmux.Snapshot to observe those identities again.

data SessionOptions Source #

Checked when creation is requested. Nothing selects native defaults. Names and paths remain literal through tmux format parsing. Environment and shell/argv bytes retain their native interpretation. Options have no Show instance because command and environment data may contain credentials.

Constructors

SessionOptions 

Fields

  • name :: !(Maybe Text)

    Literal session name, or tmux's generated name.

  • windowName :: !(Maybe TmuxText)

    Literal initial window label; the daemon validates its bytes.

  • workingDirectory :: !(Maybe PosixPath)

    Initial cwd, relative to the calling client's cwd when relative.

  • environment :: ![(PosixString, PosixString)]

    Session overrides, subject to native environment inheritance.

  • width :: !(Maybe Dimension)

    Requested cells, at most 65535; native status/layout rules still apply.

  • height :: !(Maybe Dimension)

    Requested cells, at most 65535; independent of width.

  • updateEnvironment :: !Bool

    Apply tmux's configured update-environment list from the calling client.

  • process :: !InitialProcess

    Initial process mode, separate from creation completion.

data InitialProcess Source #

Initial pane process, retaining tmux's distinct execution modes. A native argv needs at least one argument after the executable because tmux treats a single entry as shell input. DirectCommand encodes that condition.

data CreatedSession Source #

Historical identities printed during detached new-session. A later hook may already have removed them. Resolve through a fresh captured snapshot; these references do not constitute hydrated observations or prove liveness. Read these fields with record dot; construction remains private.

serverPid :: Integer
Daemon PID printed with the receipt.
session :: SessionRef
Created session in the originating generation.
window :: WindowRef
Initial physical window.
pane :: PaneRef
Initial physical pane.
windowIndex :: WindowIndex
Initial link index printed by tmux.
